changelog:
Presently API 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches an AI-powered API that transforms text input into structured, themed presentation decks.
- Supports customizable themes, color schemes, and layout options for generated slide cards.
- Provides two main endpoints: health check and presentation creation.
- Offers flexible pricing plans, including a free tier.
- Designed for developers, content creators, and businesses seeking automated presentation generation.
summary: AI-powered API for generating structured presentations from text input with customizable themes and formatting options.
